comment: DUO snapshot (Policy Registry distributed; spec vol.05 §8/§12.2.2). parents maps child DUO code -> parent DUO code. A request code is permitted by an offer's primary permission when it equals that code or is a (transitive) descendant of it. Codes under DUO:0000017 are data use modifiers: never matched as a purpose, carried over to the Agreement. Codes absent from this table are unknown: an unknown request code is not permitted; an unknown offer code only permits itself.

labels.DUO:0000006: health or medical or biomedical research (HMB)
labels.DUO:0000011: population origins or ancestry research only (POA)
labels.DUO:0000018: not for profit, non commercial use only (NPUNCU)
labels.DUO:0000044: population origins or ancestry research prohibited (NPOA)
